messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Mistake  

Hi [Colleague’s Name],  

I’m sorry for [briefly describe mistake]. It was unprofessional and I understand it caused inconvenience. I’ve taken steps to ensure it doesn’t happen again and will double‑check my work moving forward. Please let me know if there’s anything else I can do to make things right.  

Thank you for your understanding.  

Best,  
[Your Name]  

PLAN: Draft email as above; no tool calls needed.
